rationale: The workflow already applies dependency caching via Swatinem/rust-cache in every job that builds or checks Rust (test-matrix, checks, docs, min-version, fuzz, miri), so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already in place and adds nothing new. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true on test-matrix) is contraindicated: the tests job aggregates the matrix with if: always() and contains(needs.*.result, 'failure'), uploads failure artifacts, and the pattern lists "Every matrix outcome is required" and "Full failure diagnostics are required" as contraindications; canceling cells would also produce 'canceled' rather than 'failure' results, weakening required-check detection. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative successful-duration history for these jobs (miri/fuzz/docs/windows can be slow), and a blanket timeout risks failing valid runs, violating the precondition/contraindication. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is ci_service scope, not a workflow-file change. No supported, safe, coverage-preserving workflow edit remains.
